title: bidens tubuaiensis
intro: Bidens tubuaiensis, commonly known as the Tubuai Bidens or the Tubuai Marsh Cudweed, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant is traditionally used in Polynesian medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents present in Bidens tubuaiensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal activities. The plant's therapeutic actions suggest its potential use in treating various conditions, including infections, skin conditions, and possibly even some types of cancer, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
